intro: The Monarch combines simplicity with sophistication. With ergonomic armrests, soft foam cushions, and a sleek, elevated design, it’s built to bring comfort and style into smaller spaces.

features.title: Easy-to-clean synthetic leather upholstery
features.text: The Monarch sofa features synthetic leather upholstery that’s incredibly easy to clean, making it perfect for busy households or anyone who values style without the stress.

features.title: A backrest that supports where it matters
features.text: The carefully designed mid-backrest provides gentle support to your shoulders and spine, so you can sit comfortably without strain, whether for work or relaxation.

features.title: Armrests built for complete relaxation
features.text: With its wide and softly contoured armrests, this sofa creates the perfect resting spot for your arms or even a book or tablet.

features.title: Cushions that feel like a warm hug
features.text: Sink into the soft, plush foam cushioning, designed to cradle your body while offering just the right amount of support for long hours of comfort.

features.title: A raised design for a fresh, open look
features.text: Elevated with PVC legs, the Monarch not only looks light and airy but also makes cleaning underneath effortless, keeping your home neat and tidy.

name: Monarch 1-Seater Leatherette Sofa
